name: use-reduced-motion
title: useReducedMotion
description: A hook that reports whether the user prefers reduced motion and updates when the setting changes.
label: Labs examples
author: Design From Labs <https://labs.designfrom.com>

props.name: returns
props.description: true when the user prefers reduced motion; false during server rendering.

a11y: Use it to skip or shorten JavaScript-driven motion; CSS motion should use motion-safe and motion-reduce instead.
